note: the chase desk and credit terms, reconciliation and the Xero sync settings, and the forecast hooks, with their routes

areas.name: liability
areas.doc: Liability and the chase desk: the tags that mark an unpaid order, the credit terms and due date each runs to, the chase log and the chase email, and the Liability report. Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit); its routes are in gizmo/routes/liability.py. Read as `liability.NAME`.

areas.name: reconciliation
areas.doc: Reconciliation, the app's side of it: its stores, the AI call the engine (recon.py) is given, the read-only tools the chat is given, and the Xero connect walk's redirect address and sign-in tickets. Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit); its routes, with the Xero connect pair, are in gizmo/routes/reconciliation.py. Read as `reconciliation.NAME`.

areas.name: xero_sync
areas.doc: The Xero sync settings: which of the connector's settings may be read and set, and how, and the connector's address and the call to it. Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit); its route is in gizmo/routes/xero_sync.py. Read as `xerosync.NAME` (`connector` is a local name in a test).

areas.name: forecasting
areas.doc: The forecast's hooks, the app's side of the nightly forecasting service: its store, the hook token, and the figure and ledger it keeps from each run. Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit); its routes are in gizmo/routes/forecasting.py. Named apart from the forecast/ service package. Read as `forecasting.NAME`.
